data.action: 海滨咖啡车旁举起亲手打出的冰拿铁展示拉花，侧马尾迎风轻扬
data.description: 【海滨公路咖啡车·午后】栞那穿着奶油色泳装与浅色衬衫，坐在咖啡车旁的高脚凳上给自己打出一杯冰拿铁；她把拉花杯举给镜头看，海风吹动侧马尾，熟练笑容里多了假日的轻快。
data.lighting: warm afternoon light with ocean highlights
data.location: small seaside coffee cart on a coastal road
data.mood: 工作者也要享受一杯假日冰咖啡
data.promptProse: Kanna sits on a high stool beside the coastal-road coffee van in her cream swimsuit, pale overshirt and loosely tied apron. After making an iced latte, she raises its patterned glass toward the camera, side ponytail moving in the sea breeze. The horizontal medium view opens past the van counter toward water. Warm afternoon light catches the ice and pale sleeves, while ocean highlights brighten the glass against the shaded vehicle.
data.title: 明月栞那 · 海边咖啡车的冰拿铁
